purpose: Machine-readable provenance inventory for all data sources and code artifacts used in the Bounded-Belief Analytics study. Documents license terms, redistribution status, attribution requirements, and compliance risk flags.

data_sources.name: World Bank — World Development Indicators
data_sources.attribution_text: Source: World Development Indicators, The World Bank (CC BY 4.0).

data_sources.name: World Bank — Internet Users (% of population)
data_sources.attribution_text: Source: World Development Indicators, The World Bank (CC BY 4.0).

data_sources.name: OECD — Income Distribution Database (IDD)
data_sources.license: OECD Terms and Conditions — free for non-commercial research use with attribution; redistribution of bulk extracts requires OECD permission
data_sources.redistribution_note: OECD permits inclusion of limited extracts in research repositories with proper citation. Bulk redistribution may require explicit permission. The files included are analytical extracts, not full database dumps.
data_sources.attribution_text: Source: OECD Income Distribution Database (IDD), https://stats.oecd.org.
data_sources.risk_detail: Included files are analytical extracts with attribution. Bulk redistribution rights should be confirmed with OECD if challenge arises.

data_sources.name: OECD — Social Expenditure Database (SOCX)
data_sources.license: OECD Terms and Conditions — free for non-commercial research use with attribution
data_sources.redistribution_note: Same terms as OECD IDD. Analytical extracts included with citation.
data_sources.risk_detail: Same conditional redistribution terms as OECD IDD.

data_sources.name: OECD — Redistribution Metrics (derived from IDD)
data_sources.redistribution_note: Derived redistribution metrics from OECD IDD with attribution.
data_sources.attribution_text: Derived from OECD Income Distribution Database (IDD).

data_sources.name: OECD — Wealth Distribution Database
data_sources.redistribution_note: Analytical extract included with attribution. Not used in primary model but retained for auditability.

data_sources.name: World Values Survey — Time Series 1981–2022 (v5.0)
data_sources.license: WVS Data Use Agreement — free for academic research; redistribution of raw microdata files requires written permission from WVS Association
data_sources.redistribution_note: WVS raw microdata redistribution is restricted. The included file was obtained under the standard academic download agreement. Reviewers and replicators must obtain their own copy from the WVS website. The repository should document the exact version and download path.
data_sources.attribution_text: Inglehart, R. et al. (eds.). World Values Survey: All Rounds – Country-Pooled Datafile. Madrid, Spain & Vienna, Austria: JD Systems Institute & WVSA Secretariat.
data_sources.risk_detail: REDISTRIBUTION RESTRICTED. WVS microdata files should not be redistributed in a public repository. Authors must either (a) exclude raw WVS CSVs from the public repository and provide download instructions, or (b) obtain explicit redistribution permission from WVS Association.

data_sources.name: World Values Survey — Wave 7 (v6.0)
data_sources.license: WVS Data Use Agreement — same restrictions as WVS Time Series
data_sources.redistribution_note: Same redistribution restriction as WVS Time Series. Raw microdata must not be publicly redistributed without permission.
data_sources.attribution_text: Haerpfer, C. et al. (eds.). World Values Survey: Round Seven – Country-Pooled Datafile Version 6.0. Madrid, Spain & Vienna, Austria: JD Systems Institute & WVSA Secretariat.
data_sources.risk_detail: REDISTRIBUTION RESTRICTED. Same as WVS Time Series.

data_sources.name: World Values Survey — Individual Waves 1–6
data_sources.license: WVS Data Use Agreement — redistribution restricted
data_sources.redistribution_note: Individual wave microdata files carry the same redistribution restriction. Raw files should be excluded from public repositories or permission obtained.
data_sources.attribution_text: World Values Survey Association. World Values Survey, Waves 1–6.
variables_used: Cultural/belief items for longitudinal construct aggregation
data_sources.risk_detail: REDISTRIBUTION RESTRICTED. Same as WVS Time Series.

data_sources.name: European Values Study / World Values Survey — Joint Dataset (v5.0)
data_sources.license: EVS/WVS Joint Data Use Agreement — redistribution restricted for individual-level microdata
data_sources.redistribution_note: Joint EVS/WVS microdata is subject to the same redistribution restrictions as standalone WVS data. Replicators must download from the official portal.
data_sources.attribution_text: EVS/WVS (2020). European Values Study and World Values Survey: Joint EVS/WVS 2017-2022 Dataset (Joint EVS/WVS). GESIS Data Archive.
data_sources.risk_detail: REDISTRIBUTION RESTRICTED. Same as WVS data.

data_sources.name: UNDP — Human Development Report / Human Development Index
data_sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
data_sources.attribution_text: Source: UNDP Human Development Report Office, Human Development Index (HDI) data.

data_sources.name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) — Georeferenced Event Dataset & Conflict Deaths
data_sources.attribution_text: Sundberg, Ralph, and Erik Melander. 'Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset.' Journal of Peace Research 50(4). Pettersson, Therese (2023). UCDP/PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset Codebook.

data_sources.name: EM-DAT — The International Disaster Database
data_sources.license: EM-DAT custom request license — free for academic and research use with attribution; redistribution of raw downloads requires permission from CRED/UCLouvain
data_sources.redistribution_note: EM-DAT data extracts are provided under a custom academic license. The processed summary (emdat_disasters.csv) is an aggregated derivative. Raw custom-request extracts may require CRED permission for public redistribution.
data_sources.attribution_text: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain, Brussels, Belgium – www.emdat.be (D. Guha-Sapir).
data_sources.risk_detail: Processed aggregates are lower risk. Raw custom-request XLSX files may require separate redistribution permission from CRED.

derived_data.name: Upstream Integrated Country–Year Panel
derived_data.description: 22,096-row merged panel (288 countries, 1990–2023) constructed from all upstream sources. Machine-readable provenance metadata in JSON companion.
derived_data.redistribution_note: Contains columns derived from WVS microdata aggregation. Public redistribution should be reviewed against WVS terms since country-year aggregates (not individual microdata) may be permissible.

derived_data.name: Canonical Analytical Panel (23 countries, 630 rows)
derived_data.description: Complete-case analytical sample (2000–2022). Contains only country-year aggregated values — no individual-level microdata.
derived_data.redistribution_note: Country-year aggregates derived from survey data. Aggregation level is above individual respondent data, which reduces redistribution risk. However, underlying WVS terms should be reviewed for derived-aggregate policies.

code_artifacts.risk_detail: LICENSE file added: MIT for code, CC BY 4.0 for documentation and generated artifacts. Third-party data restrictions documented in LICENSE § 3.

components.description: TypeScript scripts for artifact generation, validation checks, CI gate, and replication.
Versioned WVS construct definitions and item selection rules.
13 deterministically generated JSON/CSV artifacts. Freely redistributable (code output).
Headline metrics JSON. Freely redistributable (code output).

action_items.description: WVS individual wave files (WV1–WV6), WVS Time Series, WVS Wave 7, and EVS/WVS Joint dataset carry redistribution restrictions. Before public release: either (a) exclude these files from the public repository and document download instructions, or (b) obtain written redistribution permission from WVS Association.
action_items.resolution: rawdata/.gitignore excludes all 10 restricted WVS/EVS files from version control. LICENSE § 3 documents restrictions. REPLICATION_RUNBOOK § 9 provides step-by-step download instructions.

action_items.description: Raw EM-DAT XLSX files from custom requests may require separate CRED permission for public redistribution. The processed summary CSV (emdat_disasters.csv) is lower risk as an aggregated derivative.
OECD data extracts are included as analytical subsets with attribution. Confirm that file sizes fall within OECD's permissible extract limits for research repositories.
LICENSE file added (MIT for code, CC BY 4.0 for documentation). Third-party data restrictions documented in LICENSE § 3. rawdata/.gitignore excludes redistribution-restricted files.

The canonical panel and upstream integrated panel contain country-year aggregates derived in part from WVS microdata. While aggregation reduces redistribution risk, the WVS terms should be reviewed to confirm that country-level aggregates are not considered restricted derivatives.
